label: ESTIMATOR BIAS
note: This ledger started empty. Every fact below was measured by this skill's own instrument, re-derived from scratch by scripts/discover.py by a different route, read out of the backlog, and promoted on purpose. Nothing here was copied from a plan, a paper or a sibling skill. Six measured entries were deliberately left in the backlog, each with its reason recorded beside it.

facts.claim: the decay base of the tribonacci Pisot error is 0.7373527057603276, proved by deflating the minimal polynomial and not estimated
the nearest integer to lambda**n equals the trace of the three roots for every n from 4 up, and fails to do so at n = 1 and n = 3, where the conjugate term is still above one half

a least-squares fit of the natural logarithm of the Pisot error on n, over n <= 40, returns 0.7470861243292907 against the exact base: a gap of 9.7e-03, which is 1.3 percent and shows in the second significant figure of the rate
the same fit over n <= 200 returns 0.7376706109730894, so the gap falls to 3.2e-04 once the range is five times longer, a factor of 31 down
the same fit over n <= 400 returns 0.737500724118270, a gap of 1.5e-04, which is a factor of 66 smaller than the short-range gap
the fitted base over n <= 40 exceeds the provable base by 0.009733418568963, which is 1.3 times the fit's own standard error on the slope
the fitted base over n <= 200 exceeds the provable base by 3.2e-04, which is 0.39 times the fit's own standard error and so not detectable from the fit at all
the fitted base over n <= 400 exceeds the provable base by 1.5e-04, 0.52 standard errors of the fit's own slope
the fitted base over n <= 1000 exceeds the provable base by 2.6e-05, 38 times below the 1e-03 threshold the verdict uses, so whether the estimator counts as unbiased is a property of the range

restarting the same fit at n = 4, where every term really is a Pisot error, cuts the short-range bias from 9.7e-03 to 3.6e-03, so about 63 percent of it came from the two terms that were not Pisot errors
the log-linear fit leaves an RMS residual of 0.74 nats over n <= 40, so the Pisot error is not a pure exponential and a single slope cannot describe it
the short-range gap is 1.26 standard errors of the fit's own slope, so the fit is measurably wrong and outside its error bar at the same time, and the z falls to 0.39 by n <= 200

the fit is not unbiased over the three ranges probed: at least one returns a base further than 1e-03 from the provable one, and the threshold verdict flips back to unbiased once the short range is left out
the fitted base falls below the provable one for 44 of the 398 ranges between n <= 3 and n <= 400, so the bias is not a systematic overestimate and its sign is a property of where the fit stopped

at 90 working digits the 400-term error is exactly zero and 64 of the 400 terms have no fractional part left to measure, so the wide fit is not formable and the budget formula's 188 digits is a requirement rather than a comfort
